title: API Contract Stabilizer: soft-deprecations, behavior gates, and end-to-end backcompat tests
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Purpose: Deliver a predictable path to evolve core API behaviors (streaming semantics, tool/function call wiring, and structured output enforcement) without causing customer regressions. We will implement a 'soft-deprecation' workflow where changes are gated by behavior flags, exercised in shadow/shim mode, and verified by automated end-to-end replay tests before turning defaults.

Scope:
- Define behavior gates for three areas: streaming chunk boundaries/metadata, tool-call arg/response envelope stability, and structured-output schema enforcement (strict vs permissive).
- Build a runtime-level flag system that can be toggled per-customer and per-route. Flags support: off (legacy), shadow (run new behavior and record diffs), on-but-log (new behavior active + telemetry), default-on (new behavior is default).
- Expand the regression harness: add replay jobs that run historical production traces through both legacy and candidate behavior and raise signal when diffs exceed thresholds.
- Create clear migration artifacts: a migration checklist, SDK-side opt-in helpers, and a client compatibility test suite.

Non-goals: full client SDK rollout, or new public API version numbering scheme (this work feeds into a later PM-led versioning initiative).
acceptance_criteria: Behavior gates implemented in runtime with 4 states (off, shadow, on-log, default-on) and API to set per-route/per-customer
Shadow-run path records full diff events to the backcompat index and does not affect response latencies beyond 5% p95 budget
Replay harness runs nightly on a 72-hour production trace subset and produces a daily regression report in the API-Stability dashboard
Automated test suite validates streaming boundary semantics across at least 3 client SDKs (JS, Python, Go) using prebuilt golden traces
Migration checklist + Confluence guide published and linked from the Console rollout UI
A/B rollout plan exists and has sign-off from Product, SRE, and Developer Experience
test_plan: Unit tests for gate state transitions and config propagation (CI)
Integration tests that run dual-path responses (legacy vs candidate) and assert response shape and token stream metadata parity
Replay tests: ingest anonymized 72h trace split into 10k sessions, run both behaviors, produce diffs and noise-filtered regression alerts
Performance test: confirm p95 latency overhead <=5% when shadowing enabled; validate memory/KV cache impact on 4GB LRU budget
End-to-end SDK smoke tests: JS, Python, Go sample apps invoke streaming + tool-calls with structured-output and compare outputs against golden files
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Internal opt-in: enable flags for internal accounts and run 1 week of shadow sampling (2/22 - 2/29)
Phase 1 - Early customers: invite 10 pilot customers via SEs, enable on-log for low-risk routes, monitor for 2 weeks
Phase 2 - Broad shadow: open flag to 25% of traffic on selected models/routes and run nightly replay checks for 3 weeks
Phase 3 - Progressive enable: use canary-by-route rollout with automatic rollback on regression signal threshold breaches
Phase 4 - Default flip: after zero-regressions window (30 days) schedule default-on with org-wide communication
